verdict: Reject the blanket claim that all99 post-submit terminals are unreachable in pinned official deployment. They are source-level reachable within the same ADK invocation. A tool-only view may still be a separately named current-live-original-pair-specific training view, not replacement proof that official terminal targets are useless.
scope: Read-only fixed100 source census and pinned wheel/source review; no oracle, model, HTTP, tool replay, tokenizer rerender, GPU, data filtering/export or source mutation. Only this research report/README is written.

all_terminal_bindings.important_origin: Recorded Codex off-policy recipe text after real tools, not a Gemma final response or proof of a competition model producing the same text.

task_without_terminal.reason: No text-only terminal row in this source action view.

definitions.context_input_tokens: Sum of each existing row context_tokens (=input_ids length); includes prefix and selected completion, and repeats history across rows.
definitions.prefix_tokens: Sum of existing masked prefix tokens, context_input_tokens minus selected_labels. This is row-wise repeated source/prefill token volume, not unique episode tokens or measured compute.
definitions.raw_jsonl_bytes: Exact source lines including newline; no rows are rewritten.

normal_reachable_path: Within one runner.run_async invocation, model emits submit_patch function call; ordinary FunctionTool executes the wrapper.
The tool sets ctx.patch_submitted=True and returns an ok function response; it sets neither invocation end nor skip_summarization.

swegemma does not break on that function-response event: its inner stop requires an assistant final text without function response/call. Its outer patch_submitted check is after the async iterator returns.
ADK BaseLlmFlow sees the last function-response event is not final, loops to _run_one_step_async, then _call_llm_async again when remaining budgets allow.
A post-submit assistant final text is consumed by swegemma inner stop859–862; only then outer stop920 takes effect.
pinned_official_counterexample.why_not_unreachable: Function responses are nonfinal unless a special action is set. submit_patch does not set that action. No submit-specific skip/end hook appears in the pinned swegemma or adk_submission wheels.
pinned_official_counterexample.limits: This is exact pinned source control flow, not a captured competition HTTP request or model replay. Budgets/errors may stop a particular invocation before the next request.

current_live_semantics.behavior: After real successful submit tool response is appended, the current live_pair branch immediately breaks, so it does not sample a terminal assistant response.
current_live_semantics.historical_branch_boundary: The break is inside if live_pair. Historical-three-branch does not share that immediate stop and may request another response.
current_live_semantics.comment_mismatch: The current comment claiming immediate official stop is not supported by the pinned official0.2.11/ADK1.36.1 chain.

producer.behavior: Appends reviewed recipe.final_response as an actual recorded assistant message after scripted submit; it performs no model request.

recommendation: Keep the original805 full view immutable. This audit supplies no official-unreachability reason to invalidate its99 terminal rows. If root wants active live-session alignment, generate an independent explicitly live-original-pair-specific706-tool view with the expected source-filter hash and all100 tasks, preserving raw prefixes, without model-speed/learning claims.
